baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative construction binds ءَالَاءِ, رَبِّكُمَا, and تُكَذِّبَانِ into a question addressed to two recipients.
baseline_models.mechanism: The objects are not merely pleasant possessions: the favor branch is governed by a Lord branch of repairing, administering, and completing stage by stage, while the final verb makes the recipients actively classify that care as false.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors supply the interrogated objects as concrete acts of benefaction.
Repair, nurture, and completion make lordship the process that forms each favor stage by stage.
Declaring something false turns the dual response into an active verdict on that care.

changed_reading.before: A generic rhetorical question about blessings.
changed_reading.after: An accusation asking which specific acts of stagewise nurture the paired recipients can still classify as false.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same three focus roots carry oath, pact, and charge-performance branches without leaving the verse.
baseline_models.mechanism: An oath-like object under a covenanting master can be answered not only by belief but by whether a charge is carried through. The question therefore admits a juridical co-reading in which denial is failed performance of a binding relation.

activation_trace.role: Oath-making gives the disputed object a sworn and binding edge.
A covenant or protection pact makes lordship relationally binding rather than merely titular.
A charge proving true by fulfillment or false by failure converts denial into conduct.

changed_reading.before: Denial is only an incorrect statement about divine gifts.
changed_reading.after: Denial can also be the paired recipients' failure to make a binding charge true in their conduct.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The split inventory for ءَالَاءِ permits favor and a liability that follows its holder to remain simultaneously audible.
baseline_models.mechanism: A bestowed favor does not vanish when consumed; as a following right or liability under an owner-lord, it remains attached to its recipients and can be denied but not detached. This is a double exposure, not a replacement gloss.

activation_trace.role: The dominant branch keeps the object securely grounded as bestowed favor.
The non-dominant branch contributes a right or liability that continues to follow its holder.
Ownership and authority supply the relation within which the following claim remains due.
Declaring the claim false names the recipients' attempted refusal of it.

changed_reading.before: A favor is a finished gift that can be enjoyed and left behind.
changed_reading.after: Each favor may carry a continuing claim that follows its recipients and demands acknowledgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recognition by trace, an outward mark that displays condition, seizure for an offense, and the immediately preceding explicit denial make the focus interrogative non-informational. It exposes a verdict already visible on bodies and behavior.

activation_trace.role: Declaring false supplies the act that the focus question places under examination.
Recognition after a trace or sign makes the relevant truth evidentially available.
A mark through which an observer sees a condition externalizes what denial tries to suppress.
Being taken to account for an offense converts recognition into consequence.
The explicit act of declaring the punishment false identifies the denial challenged two verses later.

structural_cues: 55:39 removes ordinary questioning, 55:41 supplies recognition and seizure, and 55:43 names denial before 55:45 asks its refrain-question.
The focus follows the witnessed punitive circuit rather than introducing new evidence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies marks, recognition, seizure, explicit denial, and their order; I infer that this order changes the question into forensic exposure. A live alternative is emphatic reminder without a courtroom mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The question invites the recipients to consider whether any favor is deniable.
changed_reading.after: The question cross-examines a denial whose falsity has already become legible, so the inability to name a deniable favor functions as verdict.

context_deltas.mechanism: The refrain stands between a closed circuit through heat and a fear-responsive standing that opens into two protected gardens. Read through lordly nurture, disclosure of the destructive circuit becomes a preventive favor: it makes danger anticipatable and therefore makes another stance possible.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favor anchors the claim that even severe disclosure can be benefaction.
Nurture and repair provide the preventive function assigned to the warning.
Circling around a thing supplies the closed punitive loop that the warning reveals.
Hot water gives the disclosed loop its physically harmful pole.
Fear as expectation of harm is the prospective response enabled by prior disclosure.
A standing or station turns fear into a durable orientation rather than momentary alarm.
A protective shield latent in the garden root supplies the outcome of heeding the warning.

structural_cues: 55:45 is the exact hinge between 55:43-44's denied punishment and 55:46's fear, standing, and two gardens.
The dual address survives the hinge, allowing the same pair to be confronted with both trajectories.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the circuit, heat, expected harm, standing, and protective enclosure; I supply the arrow disclosure -> anticipatory fear -> protection. The live alternative is that punishment is retribution only and the refrain calls it a sign rather than a preventive favor.

changed_reading.before: Punishment is an exception to the favors named by the refrain.
changed_reading.after: The truthful disclosure of punishment can itself be a favor of care because it enables fear to become a protective standing before the garden alternative.

context_deltas.mechanism: Cosmic calculation, a justice-scale, prohibition of short measure, and later collection of recompense activate the focus outlier in which favors carry rights that follow their holders. Denial becomes an attempted accounting shortfall: received care is omitted from the ledger while its attached claim remains collectible.

activation_trace.role: A liability or right following its holder makes each favor an outstanding claim.
A charge becoming true through fulfillment or false through failure models denial as failed settlement.
Counting and calculation establish an ordered rather than impressionistic field of gifts.
The scale of justice supplies the standard against which acknowledgment is measured.
Justice and equity define faithful reckoning of what has been received.
Giving short measure names the ledger-like distortion performed by denial.
Collecting and satisfying a debt confirms that outstanding claims eventually come due.

structural_cues: Calculation in 55:5 precedes the balance commands of 55:7-9, while recompense in 55:60 follows the focus.
The refrain repeatedly asks for itemization, matching the packet's ordered recurrence of particular signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies counting, just measure, shortfall, debt collection, and a branch of following liability; I infer that acknowledgment is the measured return due on received care. The alternative is ethical analogy without an actual claim structure.

changed_reading.before: The recipients are asked for an emotional admission of gratitude.
changed_reading.after: The recipients are asked to account without short measure for favors whose claims remain attached and whose denial constitutes a measurable deficit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The non-dominant sequence branch becomes formally live because the same utterance repeatedly follows successive tableaux. Its responding-voice image makes each refrain an antiphonal answer to what precedes and a summons for the two addressees to answer in turn.

activation_trace.role: A voice following another voice supplies the latent antiphonal form of the focus utterance.
Declaring false names the possible answering voice demanded from the paired hearers.
The immediately prior refrain demonstrates one responding voice in the alternating sequence.
The next refrain continues the voice-after-voice pattern beyond the focus hinge.

structural_cues: The packet records thirty non-focus occurrences of the exact refrain around the focus occurrence.
At 55:42-47, tableau, refrain, punitive circulation, focus refrain, garden promise, and refrain alternate with unusual clarity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact recurrence and the responding-voice branch; I infer a call-and-response function in which each tableau voices a claim and each refrain elicits a paired reply. The alternative is rhythmic intensification with no antiphonal agency.

changed_reading.before: 55:45 repeats a fixed sentence after another scene.
changed_reading.after: 55:45 is a responding voice in a surah-wide antiphony, turning each new scene into a claim and the two hearers into the still-unresolved answering voice.

context_deltas.mechanism: Branching growth, running sources, gushing abundance, and the closing image of stable growing good activate the non-dominant nurture-and-growth branch of رَبِّ. The favors become a regenerative system of care rather than a heap of finished rewards.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors remain the explicit category being re-read as generative processes.
The non-dominant nurture-and-growing branch gives lordship an explicitly generative motion.
A branching bough supplies self-extension and differentiation within the garden.
A source of running water supplies continuous input rather than a static object.
Water welling up abundantly intensifies the system's renewing flow.
Stable, growing good closes the sequence by naming durable increase rather than one-time receipt.

structural_cues: After 55:45, two garden sequences repeatedly alternate branching, waters, fruits, shelter, and the refrain.
55:78 closes the whole recurrent sequence with enduring increase attached again to the Lord's name.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies branching, flowing and gushing sources, growing good, and a nurture/growth branch; I infer a causal ecology sustained by lordship. The alternative is a list of independent rewards linked only rhetorically.

changed_reading.before: The favors are countable finished items displayed one after another.
changed_reading.after: The favors are mutually sustaining processes through which lordly care branches, flows, renews, and becomes stable growth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a rare animal-motion branch of ك ذ ب rather than the ordinary denial sense. It remains anchored in the focus verb and is locally reinforced by forward movement and punitive circling; downstream prose should present it as a formal image for the refrain's action, never as the verb's direct translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تُكَذِّبَانِ can retain ordinary denial while its branch image of running, stopping, and looking back models what the refrain does to moving hearers.

activation_trace.role: An animal running a stage, stopping, and looking behind supplies the refrain's arrest-and-retrospect gesture.
Advancing forward supplies the motion that judgment interrupts.
Circling supplies motion that goes on yet gets nowhere, sharpening the need to stop and look back.

changed_reading.before: The refrain merely labels the hearers as deniers after the scene has ended.
changed_reading.after: The refrain repeatedly arrests their forward or circular motion and forces a look back at the evidence just traversed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a lexically remote plant-name activation: it must not redefine ءَالَاءِ as a shrub. It remains worth carrying because the focus root itself supplies the fair-looking/bitter-tasting contrast and the verse sits between hot punitive water and branching gardens; render it only as an imagistic warning that a divine sign need not be experientially sweet.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ء ل و inventory places the ordinary favor sense beside a plant described by attractive appearance and bitter taste.

activation_trace.role: The fair-looking, bitter-tasting plant supplies a compact mismatch between appearance and encounter.
Hot water supplies the severe experiential pole immediately before the focus.
Branching boughs restore the attractive vegetal pole immediately after the hinge.

changed_reading.before: A favor must feel pleasant, so a painful warning cannot belong under ءَالَاءِ.
changed_reading.after: The sign-category can contain an appearance/encounter tension: what is bitter to undergo or hear may still disclose beneficent care.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The dyed-cloth branch is artifact-distant and cannot replace the ordinary sense of denial. It remains anchored in تُكَذِّبَانِ and gains unusual material support from coating, textile lining, and precious patterned carpets; downstream prose should qualify it as an epistemic analogy in which variegated surfaces deceive the observer.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ك ذ ب inventory allows deceptive variegated cloth to shadow the focus act of declaring false.

activation_trace.role: Deceptively variegated cloth models falsehood as capture by a persuasive surface.
Oil or coating supplies a transformed visible surface before the judgment scene.
A garment's lining introduces a concealed underside distinct from its displayed face.
Precious patterned carpets intensify the material analogy of variegated appearance.

changed_reading.before: Denial is only a false proposition spoken against obvious facts.
changed_reading.after: Denial may also be an epistemic failure that mistakes a compelling patterned surface for the whole reality and refuses its hidden structure.

strongest_changes: The focus question became forensic exposure because recognition, marks, seizure, and explicit denial precede it.
Its placement between punitive circulation and fear-led gardens made warning itself readable as preventive nurture.
Calculation, balance, short measure, and repayment strengthened the latent reading of favors as claims that remain attached to recipients.
Exact recurrence activated a coexisting antiphonal reading in which the refrain answers each tableau and solicits the pair's reply.
Garden branching, flowing water, and closing baraka changed favors from static items into a regenerative ecology of lordly care.
summary.what_was_special: 55:45 is both culmination and threshold: the same dual refrain closes a denied punitive circuit and opens a paired protected alternative. Split focus inventories allowed favor/claim, nurture/growth, and declaration/performance readings to coexist without displacing the ordinary reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The ت ل و and ر ب و target activations are structurally productive but remain form-distant and may reflect mapping resonance more than intended lexical force.
The causal arrow from disclosed danger through fear to protection is reader-supplied; the sequence also supports warning and reward as separate functions.
The plant, arrested-flight, and patterned-cloth readings are controlled analogies, not replacement glosses.
